cases.task: Using only the attached paper (chunk-recomputation-2610.31019.pdf), summarize its main claims, the evidence for each with section or table references, and the limitations the authors state. Then answer: (1) On how many of the Chinese articles did content-defined chunking fail? (2) What fraction of the embedding workload did fixed-size chunking recompute for Chinese and for English articles? (3) How many revision pairs are in the primary benchmark, and how many articles are in the common-success pool processed by all three chunkers?
